node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Encoding: wave" Audio Source: E:\Temp\Greatest Audio Destination: nul"

That makes it seem like a quoting issue I think. Unfortunately that's a nontrivial issue on Windows since, unlike *NIX, the command being called could be at fault too. Could you make sure you have the latest versions of [mod://IPC::Run3] and [mod://Win32::ShellQuote] installed, and set the environment variable IPCRUN3DEBUG=1 and report the output of that?
